name: cult-ui-text-animate
blurb: Text animates in with configurable entrance styles when scrolled into view.
description: Renders text with multiple preset animation types: fadeIn, fadeInUp, popIn, shiftInUp, rollIn, whipIn, whipInUp, and calmInUp. Triggers on scroll visibility with staggered character/word timing.
use_when: Headings need polished entrance animations with various choreography options.
avoid_when: When constant re-animations are not desired as the element scrolls.
a11y: Text is fully readable; animations are visual transitions only.
